title: Phase Zero activation checklist - metrics lab
content:
Purpose:
This Phase Zero doc is a compact preflight and metrics-lab for the first 72 hours of a feature activation. It focuses on short-cadence signals that must be green before escalating traffic, plus immediate fallback and resource plans. Intended audience: product-ops lead, SRE oncall, serving-runtime owner, solutions engineering for customers on Dedicated/Private.

Quick summary (acceptance lens):
- Canary cohort (1% traffic) must show:
  * 99.5th p95 latency <= 320ms for text-gen endpoints
  * Error rate <= 0.25% (5xx + client timeouts)
  * Cost-per-1k-tokens within +20% of forecast
  * No new model-quality regressions on canonical prompt set (auto-eval pass rate >= 95%)
- If any single metric violates threshold for 15m rolling, trigger escalation and pause ramp.

Owners + immediate responsibilities:
- Product-Ops (Maya Patel): run daily activation standup, update acceptance thermometer, own rollout cadence decisions.
- SRE (Rohan Mehta): monitor infra SLOs, verify autoscaler behavior, validate dedicated pool capacity.
- Serving runtime (Leah Kaplan): watch model load, KV cache hit-rate, and GPU memory pressure; be ready to swap to quantized variant.
- Solutions Eng (Evan Brooks): coordinate early-adopter customers, maintain a customer-facing incidents channel.

Phase Zero checklist (pre-canary, canary, ramp gates):
1) Pre-canary:
  - Telemetry: enable per-route token breakdown, cold-start traces, and streaming telemetry.
  - Baselines: capture 24h baseline for route (latency, errors, tokens, cost).
  - Model pinning: pin initial model commit + fallback variant; register model metadata in catalog.
  - Traffic filters: implement canary header and rollout percentage gate.
  - Alerts: create temporary high-sensitivity alerts for p95, p99, error-rate, cost-delta.
2) Canary (0-1% traffic, 1-2 hours steady):
  - Observe: 15m and 60m rolling windows for thresholds.
  - Manual signoff: Product-Ops and SRE to confirm green before moving to 5%.
  - Runbook ready: Slack channel, incident commander assigned, rollback play defined.
3) Early ramp (5-25%):
  - Checkpoints at 5%, 10%, 25% with 30–60m observation windows.
  - Validate autoscale under small bursts and cost telemetry agrees with forecast.
  - Spot-check quality: run random sample of 200 prompts through evaluation harness.

Gating conditions (hard-stop):
- SLO breach (p99 latency > 2x baseline) for 15m.
- Error-rate exceeds 1% sustained for 10m.
- Cache eviction rate > 30% and memory faults observed.
- Model-quality alerts: automated eval drop >= 5% on critical prompt set.

Contingencies and fallback actions:
- Immediate: reduce traffic to previous stable percentage; engage incident commander.
- If infra constrained: shift traffic to alternate region or dedicated tier; enable smaller-quantized model.
- If quality regressions: route to previous model version or apply response post-processing shim.
- Cost spike: enable short-term token-cap at proxy and pause non-critical batch jobs.

Daily metrics-lab template (what to capture each day during Phase Zero):
- Time window: 00:00–23:59 UTC
- Key metrics: total requests, avg tokens/request, p50/p95/p99 latency, error-rate, cost-per-1k tokens, model-eval-pass%, cache hit-rate, queue time, autoscaler events
- Notes column: human observations, anomalies, follow-ups (owner initials)

Example week cadence (summary):
- Day 0 (preflight): complete telemetry & baseline capture, run quick smoke tests.
- Day 1 (canary + 5%): 6h observation blocks, two signoffs.
- Day 2 (10-25%): daytime ramp with 3 checkpoints, begin customer notifications.
- Day 3 (50%): monitor regional variance, validate cost curve.
- Day 4-7: iterate, scale to 100% only after 48h of stable key signals.

Short open questions (to resolve before green):
- Should we enable optimistic batching at 25% by default or keep disabled until 50%? (action: Leah/Kaplan to recommend)
- Confirm retention of streaming traces for 7 days vs default 3 days for first-week investigations (action: Rohan)

Quick links / references:
- Confluence: Phase Zero Launch Notes (linked)
- Jira: PRODOPS-784 (activation epic)
- GH: ops PR 512 (traffic-gating change)

Immutable record: capture all signoff timestamps and owner initials in the activation-sheet linked in the epic.

Appendix: short rollback checklist (30m goal)
- Flip traffic flag to previous stable version
- Scale down new model instances manually if autoscaler stuck
- Communicate to customers via dedicated channel and status page
- Run postmortem template within 72h if degradation lasted >30m

Notes to self (working):
- Keep the metrics-lab lightweight: focus on early detection signals, not full-blown analytics.
- Maintain a portable copy of this checklist in the feature's PR for quick reference.

End of doc.
